entities.summary: Caleb Apochi Agada is a Nigerian-Canadian professional basketball player for Força Lleida of the Liga ACB. Born in Nigeria and raised in Canada, he represents the Nigerian national basketball team, and played at the 2021 Olympics. In 2020-21 he led the Israel Basketball Premier League in points per game and steals per game.
